votes.motion: Enter executive session under M.G.L. c. 30 § 21, Reason #6, to discuss purchase, exchange, taking, lease or value of real property (Northfield Road, Howard Street, New West Townsend Road) and reenter open session afterwards.
votes.quote: mr. mequaid made the motion and ms. luck seconded it. vote: ms. luck- aye, mr. mcquaid-aye, mr. toale-aye

votes.motion: Approve the entertainment license for the Lunenburg Arts Festival (June 8, rain date June 9, 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.), as amended to allow setup/breakdown and to waive the license fees.
votes.quote: mr. mequaid amended his motion to allow for setup/breakdown and to waive the license fees. ms. luck seconded the amendment. vote: all in favor

votes.motion: That the Town Manager's self-evaluation be removed from the Town Manager review document so that it is a consensus (Ms. Luck then proposed changing it to say the self-evaluation remain included).
votes.quote: that the town manager's self-evaluation be removed from this document so that it is a consensus

votes.motion: To include the numerical compilation of the Town Manager evaluation with the tabulation of 80% as part of the review document (motion later withdrawn).
votes.quote: to include the numerical compilation of the town manager evaluation with the tabulation of 80% as part of the review document

votes.motion: To include the numerical compilation of the Town Manager evaluation with the tabulation of 80% as part of the composite document.
votes.quote: discussion ensued again about the process. vote: all in favor

votes.motion: That the Board signs and submits to the Town Manager the composite with sources identified that did not come from the four members evaluations.
votes.quote: vote: 2 in favor, 2 opposed the motion fails.

votes.motion: Endorse the amended Town Manager performance evaluation with the statement and italicized sections.
votes.quote: to endorse the amended town manager performance evaluation with the statement and italicized sections 2nd: p. luck vote: all in favor

votes.motion: Authorize the Town Manager to sign a Memorandum of Understanding to have MRPC apply for the Regional Assistance Grant (Regional Energy Planning Assistance Grant).
votes.quote: to authorize town manager to sign a memorandum of understanding to have mrpc apply for the regional assistance grant vote: all in favor
to adjourn the meeting at 11:06 p.m. 2nd. p. luck vote: all in favor
